data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2020, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a profit of GBP 5.9m (2019: loss of GBP 0.2m) of which GBP 7.9m is attributable to 2020 year of account, partially offset by losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m, arising from the 2019 and 2017 & prior years of account respectively.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 133.771m (2019 closing). The year-of-account breakdown shows prior year adverse movements totalling GBP 2.0m (losses of GBP 0.1m on 2019 and GBP 1.9m on 2017 & prior), representing a modest strengthening of reserves (approximately 1.5% of opening gross claims). The report does not attribute these prior-year losses to any specific named catastrophe or external factor.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, 2019 comparative). Prior year development derived from the year-of-account result breakdown in the strategic report (sum of non-current-year components: losses of GBP 0.1m and GBP 1.9m). No explicit standalone 'movement in prior year's provision' gross note located. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 10) in GBP '000 but parsing of individual development-row cells in the provided text is noisy; RITC and LPT transactions noted elsewhere in the report may distort development comparators.
